briefs.headline: Burrow throws for 409 yards and 4 touchdowns as Bengals beat Steelers 38-18 for the AFC North lead
briefs.summary: Joe Burrow completed 35 of 44 passes for 409 yards and four touchdowns before Joe Flacco replaced him midway through the fourth quarter, and the Bengals beat Pittsburgh 38-18 at Paycor Stadium on Sunday night to take sole possession of first place in the AFC North at 7-2, per ESPN's box score and AP's game story. The line score was Cincinnati 3, 21, 7, 7 against Pittsburgh 0, 3, 0, 15: Evan McPherson's 24-yard field goal, Burrow's touchdown passes to Drew Sample (3 yards), Chase Brown (2 and 4 yards) and Dohnte Meyers (15 yards) with nine seconds left in the half, and Samaje Perine's 1-yard run, against Chris Boswell's 45-yard field goal and Aaron Rodgers' fourth-quarter touchdown passes to DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth. Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 passes for 231 yards; Rodgers was 15 of 29 for 143 yards with three sacks and no completion until his eighth attempt, and Jaylen Warren was held to 15 yards on seven carries. Cincinnati had 484 yards and 30 first downs to Pittsburgh's 222 and 17, has won five straight for its best start since 2015, and is a week removed from its win over Atlanta in Madrid. Guard Dalton Risner (left knee) and linebacker Oren Burks (groin) left the game; the Steelers lost safety DeShon Elliott to a knee injury in warmups and left guard Mason McCormick to a right ankle injury. Pittsburgh is 6-3. The Bengals play at Washington on Monday, Nov. 23, at 8:15 p.m. ET, outside this week's window.

briefs.headline: Browns rally from 17 down and beat the Texans 27-24 on Judkins' run with 53 seconds left
briefs.summary: Quinshon Judkins scored from 5 yards out with 53 seconds remaining and the Browns beat Houston 27-24 at Huntington Bank Field on Sunday after trailing 17-0 in the second quarter, per ESPN's box score and AP's game story. The line score was Houston 10, 7, 0, 7 against Cleveland 0, 10, 10, 7: C.J. Stroud's touchdown passes to Nico Collins (12 yards) and Xavier Hutchinson (11) and Ka'imi Fairbairn's 45-yard field goal built the lead; Andre Szmyt's 49-yard field goal, Deshaun Watson's 6-yard run, KC Concepcion's 6-yard run and Szmyt's 26-yard kick put Cleveland ahead 20-17 with 12 seconds left in the third; Stroud's 11-yard pass to Dalton Schultz with 9:20 to go put Houston back in front before the winning drive, which covered 49 yards in three plays after an unnecessary-roughness penalty on Kamari Lassiter and a 30-yard catch-and-run by Harold Fannin Jr. Watson, playing his former team, was 25 of 40 for 312 yards with an interception and ran eight times for 49 yards; Fannin caught seven passes for 91 yards; Stroud was 20 of 38 for 211 yards with three touchdowns and an interception. Cleveland is 6-4, with all six wins by four points or fewer and a 4-0 home record for the first time since 1963, and goes into its bye week; the next game is Las Vegas at Cleveland on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 1 p.m. ET. Houston is 3-6. Running back Woody Marks entered the concussion protocol in the third quarter; Browns end Derek Barnett left in the first quarter with a hamstring injury.

briefs.headline: Harper scores 31 and the Spurs win a 12th straight, 110 to 102 at Utah
briefs.summary: Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds and the Spurs won 110 to 102 at the Delta Center on Sunday for their 12th straight victory, sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss, per ESPN's box score and AP's game story. The quarters went San Antonio 31, 27, 23, 29 against Utah 33, 22, 26, 21. Utah led by 10 late in the first quarter and led for much of the fourth until Harper tied the game at 100 on back-to-back 3-pointers; Stephon Castle's two free throws put San Antonio ahead 102 to 100 with 2:30 left, and his steal and dunk with 47.2 seconds remaining capped a 14 to 4 closing run. Victor Wembanyama finished with 26 points, six assists and five blocks, Castle had 20 points and nine assists, and Keldon Johnson had 11 points and 10 rebounds; San Antonio outscored Utah 27 to 5 in fastbreak points. Mo Bamba scored 26 for Utah on 6 of 6 from 3-point range and Darryn Peterson had 17. The Spurs are 12 wins and two losses, level with the Lakers at the top of the Western Conference, and host Detroit on Tuesday at 8 p.m. ET.

briefs.headline: Onosato, Kirishima, Atamifuji and Wakamotoharu share the Kyushu lead at 8 wins after Day 9
briefs.summary: The Japan Sumo Association's tournament leaders page lists four rikishi (wrestlers) at eight wins and one loss after day 9 of the Kyushu basho (tournament) at the Fukuoka Kokusai Center on Monday: yokozuna (grand champion) Onosato, who forced out maegashira (rank-and-file) Takerufuji for an eighth straight win since his opening-day loss and his kachi-koshi (winning record); ozeki (champion) Kirishima, who pushed out Daieisho; sekiwake Atamifuji, who pushed out yokozuna Hoshoryu; and maegashira 7 Wakamotoharu, who pushed out Oshoma for a seventh straight win, per Kyodo and Sponichi. Kinbozan, level with them Sunday, was thrust down by Gonoyama and dropped to a second loss. Ozeki Aonishiki arm-barred Takayasu out of the ring for a fifth win, and ozeki Kotozakura was forced out by sekiwake Fujinokawa for a fourth loss, Fujinokawa's second win over an ozeki in two days after beating Aonishiki on Sunday, per Kyodo and Daily Sports; new komusubi Mimoumi fell to an eighth loss and a losing record. In juryo (the second division), Wakatakakage and Tamashoho are unbeaten at nine wins. Tamawashi, who turned 42 on Monday as the oldest wrestler in the salaried ranks, pushed down Shishi for a sixth win against three losses, per Sponichi. The final day is Sunday, Nov. 22.

briefs.headline: Hoshoryu drops to a 5th loss, the most for a yokozuna through 9 days since 2017
briefs.summary: Yokozuna (grand champion) Hoshoryu was pushed out by sekiwake Atamifuji on Monday in Fukuoka, his second straight loss, and stands at four wins and five losses after day 9 of the Kyushu basho (tournament); Nikkan Sports says it is the first time a yokozuna has reached five losses by day 9, forfeits excluded, since Kisenosato at the 2017 Kyushu tournament, and that with at most 10 wins left to him, and no top-division yusho (championship) won with 10 or fewer wins since the six-tournament calendar began in 1958, he is likely to miss the Emperor's Cup for an 11th tournament since his promotion. Sponichi's account has Hoshoryu driving Atamifuji, at 198 kilograms the heaviest man in the division, to the edge with a right inside grip before pulling the arm out for a shoulder-slap attempt and stepping out as Atamifuji turned him; he did not speak to reporters afterward. His stablemaster Tatsunami said his ring sense is not yet back after three tournaments out and that he could only respect the wrestler's wish to compete, and JSA chairman Hakkaku said Hoshoryu has no choice but to keep wrestling desperately and get his head in on the charge. He faces Takerufuji, whom he has beaten three times without a loss, on day 10. Separately, Nikkan Sports reported that maegashira 6 Kotoeiho, out since day 3 with a herniated cervical disc, returns on day 10 against Daieisho.

briefs.headline: Bills beat the Jets 31-12 for the franchise's first 8-1 start since 1991
briefs.summary: Josh Allen ran for two touchdowns and threw one to DJ Moore, James Cook ran for 157 yards including a 74-yard fourth-quarter touchdown, and Buffalo beat the Jets 31-12 at MetLife Stadium on Sunday to start 8-1 for the first time since 1991, per AP via ESPN; the Bills led only 10-6 at halftime. Allen was 11 of 21 for 196 yards with an interception, and his 325 regular-season touchdowns passed Peyton Manning for the most by a player through his first 10 seasons. Joe Brady is the third coach to win his first five road games in his first season. The Jets are 2-8 and have lost five straight.

briefs.headline: 49ers beat the Cowboys 46-40 on McCaffrey's touchdown catches of 74 and 66 yards
briefs.summary: Brock Purdy threw touchdown passes of 74 and 66 yards to Christian McCaffrey, Deebo Samuel ran 70 yards for a score on a reverse, and San Francisco beat Dallas 46-40 at AT&T Stadium on Sunday before 93,715, per AP via ESPN. The Cowboys cut a 19-point second-half deficit to six inside the final four minutes before McCaffrey's second long score on third down, which AP called the clincher; McCaffrey had 223 scrimmage yards, including a career-best 161 receiving. The 49ers are 8-1 for the second time in 15 years; Dallas is 4-6.

briefs.headline: Lions beat the Patriots 35-10 in Munich and lose Hutchinson for the season
briefs.summary: Jared Goff threw three touchdown passes, two to Amon-Ra St. Brown, and Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and two scores as Detroit beat New England 35-10 in Munich on Sunday for a fifth straight win, per AP via ESPN. New England quarterback Drake Maye left with an ankle injury on the opening drive after Aidan Hutchinson's sack, and Hutchinson hurt his right knee celebrating it; a person familiar with the situation told AP the Lions' edge rusher's injury is season-ending. Gibbs is the first player since Priest Holmes in 2002 with 150 rushing yards, two rushing touchdowns and 95 receiving yards in a game, the Lions said. Detroit is 7-2; the Patriots are 5-5 after back-to-back losses.

briefs.headline: Doncic scores 43 as the Lakers hold off the Suns 131 to 123 for an 8th straight win
briefs.summary: Luka Doncic scored 43 points with five 3-pointers and 12 of 14 free throws, his sixth 40-point game of the season, and the Lakers won 131 to 123 at Phoenix on Sunday for their eighth straight victory, playing without Austin Reaves (bruised heel), per AP via ESPN. Los Angeles led by 31 late in the third quarter before Collin Gillespie scored 12 of his 26 points in the fourth to bring the Suns within five with 1:05 left; Quentin Grimes banked in a 3-pointer with 34 seconds to go and finished with 22. Devin Booker was 4 of 14 for 17 points and sat the fourth quarter. The Lakers are 12 wins and two losses, level with San Antonio in the West.

briefs.headline: Celtics lead 42 to 9 after one quarter, a franchise record, and rout the Mavericks 131 to 94
briefs.summary: Boston led 42 to 9 at the end of the first quarter on Sunday night, the largest first-quarter lead in franchise history, and beat Dallas 131 to 94 at TD Garden for a sixth straight win and its 11th in 12 games, per AP via ESPN. Jayson Tatum scored 32 points in 30 minutes, 21 of them in the third quarter, including 13 straight to close the period; Derrick White had 16. Zaccharie Risacher scored 18 and Cooper Flagg 17 on 5 of 15 shooting for Dallas, which has lost three straight; Kyrie Irving sat out for management of his left knee a night after playing 37 minutes in Cleveland.

briefs.headline: Rockets score 147 at Washington and hold Trae Young scoreless for the first time in his career
briefs.summary: Amen Thompson scored 26 points and Kevin Durant 25, and Houston beat the Wizards 147 to 119 on Sunday night for a fourth straight win and a season high in points, per AP via ESPN. Trae Young missed all five of his shots and finished without a point for the first time in his career, after scoring in all 511 of his previous games with Atlanta and Washington. Alperen Sengun had 19 points, eight rebounds and eight assists; Houston outrebounded Washington 55 to 36 and shot 56.5% in the first half. The Wizards have lost seven straight after winning four of their first seven.

briefs.headline: Oilers beat the Flyers 5-2 as McDavid ties Gretzky's pace to 40 assists
briefs.summary: Leon Draisaitl scored twice and Connor McDavid had a goal and two assists as Edmonton beat Philadelphia 5-2 on Sunday night for a fifth straight win, per AP via ESPN; McDavid's 40th assist of the season came in the Oilers' 22nd game, matching Wayne Gretzky's 1984-85 mark for the fastest to 40, and he leads the league with 53 points. Draisaitl is the first player to 20 goals this season. Tristan Jarry made 34 saves and the Flyers were 0 for 8 on the power play. Edmonton leads the NHL with 35 points.

briefs.headline: Canucks beat the Golden Knights 6-3 to end a 7-game losing streak
briefs.summary: Filip Chytil and Linus Karlsson each scored twice and Vancouver beat Vegas 6-3 on Sunday night in Las Vegas, ending a seven-game losing streak and an eight-game losing streak against the Golden Knights, per AP via ESPN. Chytil, activated from injured reserve Friday, scored his first two goals of the season; Leevi Merilainen stopped 34 shots. Mark Stone's power-play goal tied Jonathan Marchessault's franchise record of 417 points. The Canucks had lost nine of their previous 10 and play at Utah tonight.

waters.reading: 93.8 cfs, 1.6 feet at 5:15 a.m., falling on both flow and stage against 139 cfs and 1.83 feet in the fetcher's 24-hour comparison.
waters.working: The fetcher reads the gauge at Dyer as falling, and Sunday's paper carried 106 cfs and 1.67 feet at the same hour, so the river is down about an eighth on flow and down seven hundredths of a foot on stage in 24 hours: the bump that crested Saturday is nearly spent, and the 139 cfs the fetcher's comparison names is Saturday's reading, not Sunday's, the 48-hour quirk again. At 94 cfs the Williams is back to a long-leader, small-fly problem: low, clearing water, the fish back on the pocket-water lies and the tailouts rather than the seams, and with the cold nights and short days the midday hours fish best. A size 18 to 20 midge or a small Blue-winged Olive nymph under a soft indicator on a long leader through the slower pockets and the tailouts is the pattern, with a stonefly nymph as the point fly in the deeper plunge pools where the larger fish hold in cold water; a sculpin pattern swung tight to the undercut banks is a first-hour and last-hour play now that the colour is gone.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 25.03 feet at 5 a.m., steady against 24.86 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 25.0 ft — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool with ordinary bank access, a hundredth of a foot above Sunday's printed reading and steady. The wing dams and the riprap are still showing rock and the water is clear enough to fish structure rather than the slack behind it: shad are the forage, so a white or shad-pattern swimbait or a lipless crankbait worked down the face of the wing dams and along the riprap is the pattern, slowed down for water that read frost inland overnight, with a jig and crawfish on the slack side of the lock wall for the fish holding off the current. The R.C. Byrd tailwater itself is not gauged; this is the pool side.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 26.56 feet at 5 a.m., rising against 25.91 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 26.6 ft and rising — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool and rising, a third of a foot above Sunday's printed reading and the only one of the three gauges moving up, which at this stage is the dam passing water rather than weather. Below the dam the pattern is the structure the dam makes: skipjack and shad stack in the current below the gates, and a spoon or a heavy jig worked in the churn, or a live skipjack drifted along the current seams off the lock wall, is the hybrid and catfish setup, with a little more current to work with than Sunday; the riprap along the Huntington bank fishes a crawfish-colour jig on the slack side where the bank current breaks. Huntington is the downstream bracket, 30-odd river miles below the dam, not the tailwater reading, which the Corps publish and this pipeline cannot fetch.

waters.reading: Sound at Hampstead: high 12:34 AM at 2.9 ft, low 6:34 AM at 0.8 ft, high 1:03 PM at 3.6 ft, low 7:30 PM at 0.9 ft. Surf at Ocean City Beach pier: low 5:17 AM at 1.1 ft, high 11:56 AM at 4.3 ft, low 6:31 PM at 1.1 ft, high 12:31 AM (Tue) at 3.4 ft. Water 59.4F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast, observed 5:30 a.m. Moon first quarter, 41% illuminated, 6.5 days old.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 12:34 AM and 1:03 PM in the sound.
waters.working: All four sound events land inside Monday, the first of them 34 minutes after midnight, and the surf's fourth high slips past midnight into Tuesday, tagged above. The sound lags the surf by 77 minutes on the morning low, 67 on the midday high and 59 on the evening low, the shallow sound draining slower than it fills; the table is about 50 minutes later than Sunday's, the morning flood climbs 2.8 feet from the 6:34 low to the 1:03 high and the afternoon ebb drops 2.7 feet, and at first quarter and 41% the moon is at the neap, so the inlet current is as easy as it gets this month and the swings are modest. The water at Beaufort read 59.4F at 5:30 a.m., unchanged from Sunday's reading after a second cold night; NWS Wilmington's only active product on the coast at 5:50 a.m. was a Frost Advisory for inland New Hanover County until 9 a.m., with nothing for Pender or Onslow and no rip current or beach hazards statement. No current local report could be read this morning: the Fisherman's Post Topsail and Sneads Ferry feed returned a Cloudflare 403 at 5:50 a.m., and Coastal Angler's newest Topsail report is dated Sept. 1, well past the 21-day gate, so what follows is the reference file's November pattern, not a live report: red drum, speckled trout at their prime, bluefish, spot, sea mullet and blow toads. Tied to today's table and a sound still in the 50s, the morning low at 6:34 falls in the cold and the window is the top of the flood and the first of the ebb, roughly noon to 3 p.m., once the sun has been on the flats: speckled trout in the deeper creek-channel holes and along the ICWW channel edge on a light jig head and a small soft plastic worked slowly, or a live shrimp under a popping cork drifted over the oyster bars at the creek mouths as the water starts to leave the grass. Red drum want the last of the fall, roughly 5 to the 7:30 p.m. low, which runs into dark, cut menhaden or a finger mullet on a quarter-ounce head a couple of feet off the creek-channel edges; the flooded-grass window for a weedless gold spoon is the hour before the 1:03 high. Spot and sea mullet on bloodworm or shrimp on a two-hook bottom rig in the ICWW channel on the last of the flood; bluefish are the beach fish behind the bait pods on a metal jig once the air warms. Flounder are release only.
